measurement: This is a clinician fitting tool used to take manual measurements when ordering a custom knee brace. It is not sized to the patient and is not part of the finished brace. Knee center medial and lateral position must be captured along with standard measurements. SmartMeasure apps, 3D scan files, and patient casting are also accepted in place of the caliper for a custom knee brace order. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
